text:
Lina: Thimble (our tortoise) discovered the tiny model shopping cart in the breakroom and is now on a mission. photo + short clip attached :turtle: :shopping_cart:
Sam: omg drop the pic 62d60d
Naveen: Since when did we have a mini cart? did design leave it?
Zoe: I built it for the desk diorama last week. didn’t expect it to become Thimble’s mobility device 😂
Lina: Clip: https://imgur.com/example (7s). he has a very specific clockwise route around the ficus.
Sam: that tiny cart wheel squeak is the new office ringtone :joy::sweat_smile:
Naveen: Can we get a tiny nameplate: "Thimble's Errands"? also, is he allowed near the coffee area?
ops-bot: Note: Pets allowed in common areas at host discretion. Animals must not access open food prep surfaces. Keep in carrier/leash in kitchen zone.
Lina: He stays on the checkered mat near the station. no food handling, promise.
Zoe: We should make a micro-checklist: 1) push cart 2) inspect crumbs 3) nap next to fern
Sam: volunteering as official cart pusher. will bring micro carrots tomorrow :carrot:
Lina: Micro carrots + tiny apron? :turtle::apron:
Naveen: Quick poll: should Thimble get his own emoji?
Sam: yes 100%
Zoe: yes please
Lina: I’ll ping design for a turtle+cart emoji.
ops-bot: Reminder: Health inspection Friday 09:00-11:00. Please ensure shared food areas are free of animal access during that window.
Sam: noted. cart goes on vacation during inspection 😅
Lina: thanks y'all 60a photo dump incoming in replies :)
